approved_by: Jason 2026-10-27 (no-leverage paper version, MNQ primary, 1 contract, volume roll)
source: Zarattini, Aziz & Barbon, Beat the Market: An Effective Intraday Momentum Strategy for S&P500 ETF (SPY), SFI WP 24-97 (rules read from the paper text)

data.note: practice overlaps the paper's own sample: replication check, not fresh evidence

rule.open: open of the 08:30 CT bar (cash open)
rule.move: for check time m: |close of the bar ending at m (bar starting m-1) / open - 1|
rule.sigma: mean of move at the same check time over the previous 14 NYSE sessions that have both bars; at least 10 observations, else no action at that check
rule.bands: upper = max(open, previous regular close) x (1 + sigma); lower = min(open, previous regular close) x (1 - sigma)
rule.checks: HH:00 and HH:30 CT from 09:00 to 14:30 inclusive (early-close days: to 11:30); price = close of the bar ending at the check; fills at the open of the check-minute bar; a missing check-minute bar means no action at that check
rule.entry: flat: price > upper -> long; price < lower -> short
rule.exit: long: price < max(upper, VWAP) -> exit; short: price > min(lower, VWAP) -> exit; after an exit, the opposite band breached at the same check -> reverse at the same fill
rule.vwap: cash-hours VWAP from the 08:30 bar through the bar ending at the check, typical price (high+low+close)/3 weighted by 1-minute volume
rule.end_of_day: flat at the open of the 15:00 CT bar (early-close days: the 12:00 CT bar); missing flatten bar -> non-evaluable
rule.size: 1 contract; no volatility leverage (a later, separately counted trial)
rule.costs: L3 once per round trip (a reversal is two round trips); L1-L4 reported

benchmarks.matched_control: same trades (entry/exit times), each with a random direction, 500 draws seeded [20261026, root, yyyymmdd, 5]

gates.sample_floor: at least 40 trades on MNQ, else too few to judge
gates.prop_main: Topstep 50K (rules sha256 219fab9df1fe39b02bf55fd38ec4b7e25e166f0fb54cc322ddf2768378aa31f7), frozen size 1 MNQ, 6-month budget, L3: first-account pass minus luck (at luck's best size) 90% range above 0 and median days to pass <= 126
gates.workbench_supporting: vs matched control at the noise_area family's honesty-adjusted bar; grades $5/$10/$15 per day per contract plus Sharpe >= 1.0
gates.no_retuning: if it fails, no variants of this rule; the next step is the multi-market or prop-goal decision

pre_registered_cost_expectation: from the paper's own figures: MES paper-level edge ~$9-10/day vs ~$11/day L3 costs (cannot survive); MNQ ~$15/day vs ~$6/day (room)
